To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
China’s textile and clothing industry has a huge potential for development.
the textile and apparel industries in the United States and China have a high degree of complementarity and are highly competitive.
the Chinese textile industry has been affected by Sino-US trade frictions and has experienced a series of negative consequences.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the analysis of the textile and apparel industry of China and the USA, the textile and apparel disputes between them, and the analysis of Sino-US textile disputes with Game Theory.
the analysis of the Sina-US textile and apparel frictions with Game Theory and the policy recommendations.

the following aspects: 1) The Sino-US textile trade status and its development. 2) The Sino-American textile and apparel trade frictions. 3) The analysis of the Sono-American textile and apparel frictions with Game Theory and its application to China's textile and apparel industry.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the textile and apparel industry in China should actively take part in the WTO,strengthening the construction of the industrial chain and the value chain of the textile and apparel enterprises and promoting the development of China’s textile and clothing trade.

, in the long term, the Chinese textile and apparel enterprises should be encouraged to develop their own brands, and the Chinese government should be encouraged to improve the quality of the textile and apparel products and the level of the service, in order to enhance China's international competitive advantage.
the textile and apparel industry of China is in a period of great development and has a bright future, but there is also a long way ahead for the industry to go.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the textile and apparel industry of China is an export-oriented and the textile and apparel products are the main export products in China. China's textile and apparel exports have been growing rapidly in recent years.

we should make full use of the advantages and opportunities brought by the accession to the WTO and make our textile and apparel industry more competitive in the international market,thus making the industry develop better and better.
the Sino-US trade frictions in textile and apparel field are mainly the result of the different development stages of both countries and the unfair trade practices of the US.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the government should pay attention to the development of the textile and apparel industry and the development of the domestic market.
China and the United State can reach a win-win solution through cooperation and mutual benefit.
China should strengthen its own competitiveness,improve the quality of products,enhance its brand image and improve its international competitiveness in the textile and apparel industry.
